title: Borrower Notice and Correspondence Periods, Property Charge Advance Repayment
content:
Every Property Charge Advance Repayment record runs on fixed periods counted in calendar days: the notice period after the record opens, the window for a lump-sum repayment, the time borrowers have to sign an issued agreement, and the deadlines for the advance notice and the completion letter. Advance and default notices go by first-class mail and email.

| Arrangement | Notice period after the record opened | Lump-sum repayment must arrive within (days after the record opened) | Every borrower signs within (days after issue) | Advance notice within (days after the advance) | Completion letter within (days after completion) | Notice channels |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lump-Sum Repayment | 30 | 30 | 15 | 10 | 10 | First-class mail; email |
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | 30 | 0 (not lump-sum) | 15 | 10 | 10 | First-class mail; email |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | 30 | 0 (not lump-sum) | 15 | 10 | 10 | First-class mail; email |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | 30 | 0 (not lump-sum) | 15 | 10 | 10 | First-class mail; email |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | 30 | 0 (not lump-sum) | 15 | 10 | 10 | First-class mail; email |
| At-Risk Extension | 30 | 0 (not lump-sum) | 15 | 10 | 10 | First-class mail; email |

All periods are calendar days. The notice period is the time within which the borrower must repay in full or choose an arrangement. The lump-sum window is set only for the Lump-Sum Repayment; a figure of 0 marks an arrangement that is not a lump-sum repayment.

## Questions on these periods

**What does the notice period measure?**
Thirty calendar days, counted from the opening of the arrangement record, within which the borrower must repay in full or choose an arrangement. The same figure applies whatever arrangement is later chosen.

**How long do borrowers have to sign an issued agreement?**
Fifteen calendar days after the agreement is issued, in every arrangement.

**How soon is a borrower told of a new advance?**
Within 10 calendar days after the advance.

**How soon does the completion letter follow?**
Within 10 calendar days after the record is completed.
